paragraphs.text: Rarp was a goblin of Squee 's kingdom, who became Phyrexianized .

Rarp was a goblin stone jockey from Squee 's clan, tasked with managing a defensive mechanism involving large boulders at the mountain's entrance. His history took a dark turn when an accident caused a rope to snap, and Rarp was crushed under a falling boulder. Despite the seemingly fatal injuries, Rarp survived, only to reveal a more sinister transformation: black oil leaking from his eyes and a glistening black metal cable under his skin exposed him as a sleeper agent corrupted by Phyrexian technology. This alarming discovery not only marked the unexpected survival of Rarp but also signaled the potential return of the Phyrexian threat, long thought defeated. Squee used a mana torch to identify a golden sheen in Rarp's eyes before he burned Rarp to death.
